_how: One entry per brand. Every loop runs for each client with enabled: true. To add a client, copy a block, change the slug (must match the Hub Clients tab brand and brands/<slug>/), and fill in who they talk to. Optional: site (monthly site + AI search check), ai_prompts (3 asked per month, rotating), engage (true = daily comment drafts from the outreach Sheet; Open Frame only for now). listings (agency | local | nonprofit) = directories loop. city + event_feeds (RSS, iCal, or any page with event schema; dead feeds switch themselves off) = events loop. gbp = weekly Google Business post draft.

open-frame.name: Open Frame
open-frame.audience: Mission-driven organizations and small brands (nonprofits, guilds, local businesses) who find design and marketing hard to keep up with
open-frame.promise: Makes design and marketing easy and attainable for mission-driven organizations, so they stand out while staying true to who they are
open-frame.voice: Short, warm, plain. A person talking, not a brand announcing. Concrete examples over claims.
